summary: Adds a Rust/Buck2 read-only checker for agent hook runtime manifest/config drift and removes embedded Python manifest validation from the shell hook harness.

facets.F1_scope: P00 read-only hook enhancement backlog slice; no runtime hook behavior mutation beyond checker evidence wiring.
F3_tests: bash scripts/tests/governance-hooks-retired-vcs-surfaces.test.sh; governance hook retired VCS/wrapper surface tests passed
facets.F4_security: Checker rejects runtime network/remote command tokens, agent recursion, git push, destructive cleanup, OMC/OMX coupling, retired canonical primitive markdown, and retired Oya wrapper guidance in active runtime hooks.
facets.F5_privacy: No tenant/user data touched; checker reads repo-local configs and hook source only.
facets.F6_reliability: Buck2 target fails closed on manifest/config drift, unreferenced hooks, unmanifested config commands, non-executable shell hooks, and Claude project runtime hook reintroduction.
facets.F7_operability: Runtime hooks remain advisory/read-only; enforcement authority is Buck2/Prow repo-hygiene evidence.
facets.F8_performance: Small rustc-only checker; no network calls or live service dependency.
facets.F9_maintainability: Moves JSON manifest validation out of embedded Python into named Rust source with unit tests.
facets.F10_compatibility: Preserves existing Codex/Gemini hook commands and Claude/OMC boundary.
facets.F11_supply_chain: No new dependencies; standard-library Rust only.
facets.F13_traceability: Masterplan P00 success criteria and repo-hygiene backlog now name //:agent-hook-runtime-manifest-check.
